[[FC Nantes]] won '''Division 1 season 1965/1966''' of the [[Ligue de Football Professionnel|French Association Football League]] with 60 points.

Promoted from [[Ligue 2|Division 2]], who will play in [[French soccer Division 1 1966/1967|Division 1 season 1966/1967]]
* [[Stade de Reims]]: Champion of [[Ligue 2|Division 2]]
* [[Olympique de Marseille]]: runner-up of [[Ligue 2|Division 2]]

Merger at the end of the season
* [[UA Sedan-Torcy]] with [[RC Paris]], become [[RC Paris-Sedan]]
